def bbox(frame,color,lo=30,hi=200):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and lo<n['pixels']<hi:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out

def bbox(frame,color,lo=30,hi=200):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and lo<n['pixels']<hi:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out
